big_case.notes: End-stage capital stay application on recurring Florida clemency-discretion and clemency-records claims that the Court had turned away in other Florida warrant cases within the preceding weeks; denied with the linked certiorari petition in a one-sentence unsigned order, no writing or noted dissent, no amicus participation. The stakes for the applicant are total, but the doctrinal and public significance beyond the execution itself is low.

leakage.notes: Forward cell. Every logged call is timestamped 17-18 Nov 2026, before the 19 Nov resolution; the log and prose show no retrieved document dated on or after resolution, no disposing order, and no read under data/qp-topics/. Capture coverage is partial (CourtListener calls unobserved), so those calls are graded on their queries: a citation search for 66 F.4th 896 and a fetch of that 2023 Eleventh Circuit opinion (Barwick), neither about this application. The one corpus citation lookup and a generic prior-Term denial query did not target this docket. The candidate states it did not retrieve this application's docket or the linked petition's disposition.
